domains.label: Feed additives
domains.description: Additives used in animal nutrition (Regulation (EC) No 1831/2003): identity, characterisation, safety for target species, consumers, users and the environment, efficacy.
domains.assistant_role: EFSA scientific officers assessing feed additives

domains.label: Food additives
domains.description: Additives intentionally added to food (Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008), including re-evaluations.

domains.label: Food flavourings and smoke flavourings
domains.description: Flavouring substances (Regulation (EC) No 1334/2008) and smoke flavourings (Regulation (EC) No 2065/2003).

domains.label: Food enzymes
domains.description: Food enzymes (Regulation (EC) No 1332/2008), including production strains.

domains.label: Food contact materials
domains.description: Substances in materials and articles in contact with food (Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004).

domains.label: Novel foods, nutrition and food supplements
domains.description: Novel and traditional foods (Regulation (EU) 2015/2283), nutrient sources, health claims.

domains.label: Genetically modified organisms
domains.description: GM food and feed (Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003) and environmental release (Directive 2001/18/EC).

domains.label: Plant protection products and residues
domains.description: Active substances (Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009) and maximum residue levels (Regulation (EC) No 396/2005).

domains.label: Contaminants in the food chain
domains.description: Chemical contaminants and undesirable substances in food and feed.

domains.label: Biological hazards
domains.description: Microbiological hazards, food hygiene, QPS, antimicrobial resistance.

domains.label: Chemical hazard assessment with NAMs and AOPs
domains.description: New approach methodologies, Adverse Outcome Pathways and in-vitro to in-vivo extrapolation for any chemical.

domains.label: Other / not listed
domains.description: Any other food or feed safety question.
